# SASInsight

Read `AGENTS.md` before doing project work. This is a skills-led SAS reverse-engineering and architecture-drafting workspace, not a migration engine.

For intake-to-output requests, invoke `.agents/skills/orchestrate/SKILL.md`; it routes understand → specify → design → review → package. Continue routine draft stages without asking approval at every step. Stop for critical missing evidence, unavailable permissions or final human review.

Keep `intake/` unchanged and private. Keep generated outputs in a fresh `output/<run-id>/`. Do not run SAS or source scripts. Load skill bodies only as needed and never replace them with generated analysis scripts. Respect the evidence and human-authority rules in AGENTS.md.
